name.ja: ENTRY GRADE 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人 ベジータ
name.en: ENTRY GRADE Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Vegeta

description.ja: 全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に『ドラゴンボール超』より超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ベジータが登場！
description.en: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Vegeta from "Dragon Ball Super " appears in the introductory series " ENTRY GRADE" given to all plastic model inexperienced people!

description.ja: • 迫力の肉体造形！関節の形状に渾身のこだわり、筋肉の造形も細部まで演出。
description.en: • Impressive body modeling! Great attention has been paid to the shape of the joints, and even the details of the muscles have been created.

description.ja: • 髪の毛はパーツの分割により複雑な形状を再現。
description.en: • The complex shape of the hair is reproduced by dividing the hair into parts.

description.ja: • 瞳と眉毛はパーツの分割色分けで再現。
description.en: • Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced by dividing and color-coding the parts.

description.ja: • 総パーツ数35。接着剤、工具不要！スナップフィット、タッチゲート方式で簡単組み立て！
description.en: • Total number of parts: 35. No glue or tools required! Easy assembly with snap fit and touch gate method!
